SELECT pc.id, pd.sku_no, pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url, att.id as attachmentId, att.attach_name, att.attach_url,
FROM product_detail pd INNER JOIN product_certificate pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE inner join ( select id,business_id,attach_name,attach_url from attachment where id in ( select max(id) from attachment where is_deleted = false group by business_id ) ) att on pc.id = att.business_id WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc,pc.update_time desc

SELECT pc.id, pd.sku_no, pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url, att.id as attachmentId, att.attach_name, att.attach_url,
FROM product_detail pd INNER JOIN product_certificate pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE inner join ( select id,business_id,attach_name,attach_url from attachment where id in ( select max(id) from attachment where is_deleted = false group by business_id ) ) att on pc.id = att.business_id WHERE pd.id = #{skuId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc,pc.update_time desc
